label: Figure 11.2: The profit-maximizing level of output in perfect competition
alt: Industry supply and demand set price P; the firm takes P as its horizontal D = AR = MR line and maximises profit at output q where the rising MC curve cuts it.
caption: The firm takes the market price P from the industry graph, so P = D = AR = MR. Profit is maximised at output q, where MC = MR. Firm output q is only a tiny fraction of industry output Q; if it were large enough to shift industry supply the firm would have market power.
